status: implemented and deployed for scoped testing; full Phase 1/2 certification remains partial

verification.realWorkflowRunner: passed with simulated authenticated browser recipients and actual runner/action-policy/approval DB
verification.browserReleaseBoundary: 14 local PDF/PNG checks on G; 8 cross-domain checks on J. The intervening changes add sharing error guidance and uploader-only Remove visibility; J also passed all 197 application tests.

cases.evidence: Actual deployed parser/model: TXT, PDF, DOCX, PNG and JPEG, three correct fields and citations each. PDF/PNG Chrome uploads and summaries passed.
cases.recommendation: Retain this synthetic corpus as a release gate; additional languages/handwriting are unsupported.

cases.feature: Reviewed fill and independent Save proof
cases.evidence: PDF and PNG: fresh Customer field review, explicit fill, separate synthetic Save; exact returned record UUID and three values independently read back.
cases.recommendation: Keep business-save readback host-specific. Observed fields alone never prove persistence.

cases.evidence: Both browser runs navigated from Customer to Note then freshly inspected/filled. Unit cases reject invented values, missing/conflicting/repeated labels.
cases.recommendation: Expand custom-control coverage per host before advertising support.

cases.evidence: Capability separation, extension/MIME/signature/binary/size limits and instruction rejection pass. No private upload publishes shared sources.
cases.recommendation: Keep supported formats explicit; add separate acceptance before adding languages/file types.

cases.evidence: Anonymous live Chrome panels on loopback Customer and public flolah.cloud MCP Universe paired with bilateral confirmation; each panel displayed the other exact origin.
cases.recommendation: Use fresh pairing codes and current preview authorization for future releases; pairing remains user consent rather than device attestation.

cases.evidence: Wrong owner, expiry/reuse, foreign instance/session, conflicting user links and unrelated group tests pass.
cases.recommendation: Pairing is explicit user consent, not proof of a single physical device.

cases.feature: Private handoff to public destination form
cases.evidence: Sharing without consent rejected; with consent, private integration passages reached the public panel. Real model proposed Inventory API and stdio from the file. Controls remained blank until approval, then both values were independently observed; no public submission.
cases.recommendation: Keep destination inspection and review; never interpret filled controls as a saved business record. Future website fixtures must supply their own observed controls.

cases.evidence: Connector editor built/deployed; normal auth/workflows entitlement, actor/group isolation, system-trigger identity and actual runner tests pass.
cases.recommendation: Complete a signed-in entitled test-user journey through the deployed editor and paired group.

cases.evidence: Selected websites/all-active exact snapshot; missing selected website, unrelated groups/new arrivals, busy tabs and duplicate operations tested.
cases.recommendation: Retain runtime snapshot preflight; never queue for future visitors.

cases.evidence: Actual runner passes autonomous/prohibited/exact approval fanout, maxUses override exhaustion and single-use grants. Per-effect revalidation/binding tests pass.
cases.recommendation: Complete signed-in browser workflow fill and owner-bound native Save with independent host readback.

cases.evidence: Disconnect and lost acknowledgement tests fail explicitly; duplicate commands join once; peer failure blocks remaining plans/effects; runner bypasses automatic replay.
cases.recommendation: Add real browser lost-ack/native-Save and signed-in disconnect journeys; report unknown outcomes without retry.

cases.evidence: End/expiry/restart/revocation tests pass; live canary absent SQLite rows and consistent checkpoint; raw objects ciphertext only; ending task leaves zero bytes/backlog. Both panel logs/reviews/files clear. Public recipient shows shared-file status without unauthorized Remove control; End task clears both cross-origin panels.
cases.recommendation: Verify final zero private metrics after each release and preserve encrypted-object/key separation.

cases.evidence: Task-only result handles and real runner persisted context/step canary checks pass; ordinary private chat never enters durable history.
cases.recommendation: Broaden downstream node/template/tool/Kanban/telemetry adversarial matrix; document actual upstream provider retention.

cases.evidence: 1 CPU/1 GiB isolated VPS: 50 authenticated WS, 25 UTF-8 files, 2 Python workers, 50 fanout recipients and 250 HTTP requests; p95 4 ms, RSS 90 MiB, extraction 3150 ms, event-loop p99 33 ms.
cases.recommendation: Short synthetic pilot excludes full concurrent model/OCR/provider latency, soak and multi-coordinator HA. Measure these before scaling beyond the pilot.

cases.evidence: Ordinary public homepage has no copilot; explicitly opted-in MCP page loads it. Live cross-domain run recorded zero public write requests, zero login visits and zero public submit events. Laptop listener and VPS API host binding remain loopback.
cases.recommendation: Approved preview expires at 15:17 Singapore on 18 October 2026. Public browser acceptance remains no-login/no-submit.

testing.transactionFile: Generate via test/make-transaction-fixtures.py; local synthetic PDF/PNG available in .local/private-preview/transaction-corpus/
testing.workflow: Flolah Workflow Editor > connector > Digital Adoption Copilot. Pair panels; Link group; consume code as entitled Flolah user; select group/websites/action. Copy Task ID from panel to join existing visitor task.

deploymentBoundary: One stateful coordinator, local SQLite and ephemeral private keys; two parser workers. Private ports 4196/4197 unpublished. Approved opt-in public preview expires 18 October 2026 at 15:17 Singapore.
